verdict.rationale: gstack documents an explicit update command: the /gstack-upgrade skill detects whether the install is global or vendored, runs the upgrade, and shows what's new. It also documents an opt-in auto-upgrade switch, GSTACK_AUTO_UPGRADE, so fixes arrive without reinstalling from scratch. missing for 10: independent or hands-on corroboration that upgrades work smoothly, and fuller documentation of auto-upgrade behavior (cadence, rollback, version pinning).
